lines.text: Jesus returned to Galilee in the power of the Spirit and taught in their synagogues, and everyone glorified Him.
On the Sabbath in Nazareth, Jesus stood to read in the synagogue, and the scroll of Jeremiah was handed to Him.
Jesus sat down and said the Scripture was fulfilled that day, and the people asked if He was the son of Joseph.
Jesus said that in Elijah's time the widow of Zarephath was the one sent to, and only Hazael the Syrian was cleansed of leprosy.
The enraged crowd drove Jesus out of town and led Him to the brow of the hill, but He passed through them.
